isItNecessaryToHaveACorporate.content: No, a commercial registry is not necessary for the store unless you would like to link the store with payment gateways to provide payment services such as Mada, Visa, Mastercard, or Apple Pay.
isItNecessaryToHaveACorporate.recommended: However, it is recommended to obtain a commercial registry to preserve and validate your identity, as well as increase customer confidence in your store and brand.
